BackstoryDef.title: cub loon chaser
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] would spend hours each day chasing the local chub loons around the coast. [PAWN_nameDef] never got close to actually catching one, which is quite an accomplishment as chub loons aren't exactly fast on land.

BackstoryDef.title: echatere herder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] would always tell everyone how [PAWN_pronoun] helped to herd the tame echatere. In truth, [PAWN_nameDef] was bait, [PAWN_pronoun]. Would whistle, and then [PAWN_pronoun] would run.

BackstoryDef.title: tiny warrior
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was practically born with a sword in [PAWN_possessive] hands. Every day since [PAWN_pronoun] would walk [PAWN_nameDef], was out in the fields, swinging away at anything that got too close. Luckily [PAWN_nameDef] was smart, and kept [PAWN_possessive] distance from the echatere herd.

BackstoryDef.title: welwa trainer
BackstoryDef.description: Somewhat skilled with animals, and secretly terrified of echatere, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to instead put [PAWN_possessive] skills to work training welwa. While comparatively safer to be around than echatere, [PAWN_nameDef] did nearly lose fingers a few times.

BackstoryDef.title: echatere tender
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] wasn't skilled enough to actually tame echatere, [PAWN_pronoun] did help tend the herds. Taking care of echatere was tough work, as echatere aren't very friendly, even 'tame' ones. [PAWN_nameDef] was sure [PAWN_pronoun] spent more time tending to wounds than actually taking care of the echatere.

BackstoryDef.title: echatere tamer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the few Orsimer brave enough to tame wild echatere. [PAWN_pronoun] was also smart enough to know that even a tame echatere was still wild.

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold builder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped [PAWN_possessive] tribe construct new strongholds whenever the tribe was forced to move. This happened rather often, so [PAWN_nameDef] became quite skilled at construction.

BackstoryDef.title: echatere cheese maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent much of the day making cheese out of echatere milk. Partly because [PAWN_pronoun] was reasonably good at it, partly because it helped keep a roof over [PAWN_possessive] head, but also partly because echatere cheese is supposedly an aphrodisiac. Though [PAWN_nameDef] could never confirm the truth about that last reason.

BackstoryDef.title: intricate Orcish smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was rather skilled at crafting traditional Orsimer armor. Not the primitive stuff the less experienced Orsimer make, but instead finely crafted armor fit for a warrior of stature. Needless to say [PAWN_possessive] crafts were more popular with Imperials than with Orsimer.

BackstoryDef.title: simple Orcish smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made armor for [PAWN_possessive] stronghold. Not the needlessly fancy stuff, but the simple stuff that protects you, and does a good job at it. There was also the bonus that this armor was easy to make, which meant [PAWN_nameDef] often had quite a bit of spare time. [PAWN_pronoun] usually spent this time roasting meat in the forge.

BackstoryDef.title: berserker
BackstoryDef.description: Skilled with what ever weapon [PAWN_pronoun] could get [PAWN_possessive] hands on, as long as it wasn't a bow, [PAWN_nameDef] was a fearsome sight on the battlefield. Though [PAWN_pronoun] did have a tendency to ignore any potentially life-threatening wounds acquired during battle.

BackstoryDef.title: great warrior
BackstoryDef.description: One of the most skilled warriors in [PAWN_possessive] stronghold, [PAWN_nameDef] over time grew tired of dealing with foes that offered little threat. So [PAWN_pronoun] set out into the world in search of a legendary fight, or an honorable death.

BackstoryDef.title: orichalcum miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in the orichalcum mine controlled by [PAWN_possessive] stronghold. While raw orichalcum was surprisingly easy to excavate, the mines themselves seemed to often end up infested by various vermin, which is where [PAWN_nameDef]'s other skill came in handy.

BackstoryDef.title: master orichalcum smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had trained under the watchful eye of one of the best smiths in Orsinium, who in turn had also trained been trained by a master smith. Thanks to this opportunity, [PAWN_nameDef] followed in the footsteps of [PAWN_possessive] master, and became highly skilled at working orichalcum. A truly temperamental metal, just like [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold whelp
BackstoryDef.description: Stronghold children fight over food, and the adults take notes. [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that hitting first saves arguing later.

BackstoryDef.title: forge bellows child
BackstoryDef.description: Orcish steel needs a hot fire and somebody to keep it hot. [PAWN_nameDef] worked the bellows until both arms looked borrowed from someone bigger.

BackstoryDef.title: wise woman's helper
BackstoryDef.description: A stronghold's wise woman gathers herbs, patches wounds and frightens the chief. [PAWN_nameDef] carried her basket and studied the third skill closely.

BackstoryDef.title: Orsinium ruins child
BackstoryDef.description: Orsinium has been knocked down more than once. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among the broken walls, stacking back what could still be stacked.

BackstoryDef.title: mine runner
BackstoryDef.description: Small enough for the narrow seams, [PAWN_nameDef] brought up ore before ever seeing a full day of sun. Orcs don't consider this unusual.

BackstoryDef.title: Code of Malacath pupil
BackstoryDef.description: The Code says what is owed when someone wrongs you. [PAWN_nameDef] could recite the whole thing at seven, and used it mostly against siblings.

BackstoryDef.title: chief's youngest
BackstoryDef.description: Being the chief's youngest means a lot of older siblings with something to prove. [PAWN_nameDef] got good at reading a room and leaving it.

BackstoryDef.title: welwa hunter's child
BackstoryDef.description: A welwa will stalk you for miles if it gets curious. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to shoot young, since a stronghold's walls only help so much.

BackstoryDef.title: Wrothgar mountain child
BackstoryDef.description: Winter comes early in Wrothgar and leaves late. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up breaking ice for water and being told it used to be colder.

BackstoryDef.title: outcast's child
BackstoryDef.description: A clan can cast out one of its own, and the children go too. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a hut outside the wall, close enough to smell the supper.

BackstoryDef.title: Bangkorai border child
BackstoryDef.description: Bretons and Redguards both claim the hills around Bangkorai, and neither much like Orcs. [PAWN_nameDef] learned their insults in two languages.

BackstoryDef.title: shield polisher
BackstoryDef.description: Veterans don't polish their own shields when there's a child handy. [PAWN_nameDef] did the polishing and got told how each dent had happened.

BackstoryDef.title: blood-kin fosterling
BackstoryDef.description: Two strongholds swapped children to seal a truce. [PAWN_nameDef] spent six years as a promise, fed well and watched closely.

BackstoryDef.title: Skyrim stronghold child
BackstoryDef.description: Life at Dushnikh Yal or Largashbur is cold and very direct. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up carrying ore in a land that would prefer you didn't.

BackstoryDef.title: tusk filer
BackstoryDef.description: Young Orcs get vain about their tusks at a certain age. [PAWN_nameDef] charged the others in dried meat to file theirs to a good point.

BackstoryDef.title: Trinimac story listener
BackstoryDef.description: An old grandmother said the Orsimer were once elves of a great god, before Boethiah ate him. [PAWN_nameDef] asked questions until told to go fetch wood.

BackstoryDef.title: wolf-pup thief
BackstoryDef.description: There was a den on the north ridge, and then [PAWN_nameDef] came home with a pup under one arm. The clan let [PAWN_objective] keep it, for the entertainment.

BackstoryDef.title: smith's second apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: The first apprentice got the fine work. [PAWN_nameDef] got the hinges, the nails and a thorough education in why nails matter.

BackstoryDef.title: stew tender
BackstoryDef.description: A stronghold pot never goes empty and never gets cleaned. [PAWN_nameDef] kept it going all year and took great pride in its depth.

BackstoryDef.title: wall builder's child
BackstoryDef.description: Orcs don't trust a wall they didn't build, and rarely trust those either. [PAWN_nameDef] carried stones until knowing every course by touch.

BackstoryDef.title: duel witness
BackstoryDef.description: Duels in a stronghold need witnesses, and children have good memories. [PAWN_nameDef] saw eleven before age ten and could say who cheated.

BackstoryDef.title: tannery child
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody visits the tanner's family. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with the stink, the scraped hides and a great deal of peace and quiet.

BackstoryDef.title: goat thief
BackstoryDef.description: Neighboring farmers kept their goats poorly watched, in [PAWN_nameDef]'s considered opinion. Several were reassigned to better homes.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial foundling
BackstoryDef.description: An Orc baby left at an Imperial shrine is a problem for everyone. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a kind house and was stared at in every street.

BackstoryDef.title: war orphan
BackstoryDef.description: Wars pass over Orc lands on their way to somewhere important. [PAWN_nameDef] lost a family to a passing army that never learned their names.

BackstoryDef.title: wood gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Forges eat wood by the cartload. [PAWN_nameDef] walked further for it every year and came to know each tree on the mountain.

BackstoryDef.title: horn blower
BackstoryDef.description: The stronghold's horn signals everything from a raid to dinner. [PAWN_nameDef] took it over when the old blower's teeth went, and got fond of the attention.

BackstoryDef.title: arena runt
BackstoryDef.description: Fighting pits take the small ones for the crowd's amusement. [PAWN_nameDef] was small for about one more year.

BackstoryDef.title: bone stacker
BackstoryDef.description: Ancestors go in the clan's bone hall, tidily. [PAWN_nameDef] looked after the stacks and could say who had which bad knee.

BackstoryDef.title: ore sorter
BackstoryDef.description: Good orichalcum looks a lot like bad rock until you know better. [PAWN_nameDef] got to know better, and nobody could fool [PAWN_objective] on weight.

BackstoryDef.title: peddler's tag-along
BackstoryDef.description: A Khajiit peddler came by each year and [PAWN_nameDef] finally followed the cart. The peddler taught haggling and sent the child home after a season.

BackstoryDef.title: ice fisher
BackstoryDef.description: There's a lake above the stronghold that gives up fish only through a hole. [PAWN_nameDef] sat over it for a good part of every winter.

BackstoryDef.title: shaman's drum carrier
BackstoryDef.description: Certain rites need a certain drum, and it weighs more than you'd think. [PAWN_nameDef] carried it up the mountain each new moon.

BackstoryDef.title: hard-headed runt
BackstoryDef.description: Being kicked by an echatere killed most who tried it. [PAWN_nameDef] walked it off and got a reputation, and a slight tilt of the head.

BackstoryDef.title: armor mender's child
BackstoryDef.description: Mended armor comes back with a story and usually a bloodstain. [PAWN_nameDef] sat among it all, stitching straps and asking who had won.

BackstoryDef.title: Malacath shrine keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Prayers to Malacath tend to be complaints. [PAWN_nameDef] heard many of them while clearing the offerings, and learned who was angry at whom.

BackstoryDef.title: lost in the Wrothgar snow
BackstoryDef.description: A blizzard kept [PAWN_nameDef] out for three nights. The clan had already divided the spare boots when the child walked back in.

BackstoryDef.title: chain carrier
BackstoryDef.description: Mine chain comes in long loops and no one wants to carry it. [PAWN_nameDef] did, and has unusually large shoulders because of it.

BackstoryDef.title: tribal debt payer
BackstoryDef.description: An uncle's blood price had to be worked off, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the available family. Three years at another clan's forge settled the matter.

BackstoryDef.title: mead brewer's child
BackstoryDef.description: Orcish mead can peel varnish. [PAWN_nameDef] got to stir and taste, which explains a fair amount about later judgment.

BackstoryDef.title: clan's first reader
BackstoryDef.description: No one in the clan could read when a battered book came through. [PAWN_nameDef] worked it out alone over a whole winter, mostly to prove someone wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: bear-hide wearer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tracked a young bear for days to prove a point. The hide didn't fit, and [PAWN_pronoun] wore it for two years regardless.

BackstoryDef.title: gate watch child
BackstoryDef.description: Children make good lookouts because they get bored and look at everything. [PAWN_nameDef] once spotted a raid hours before the sentries.

BackstoryDef.title: quiet one
BackstoryDef.description: A stronghold is loud, and [PAWN_nameDef] was not. Drawings on the walls behind the smokehouse were the only sign anyone noticed for some years.

BackstoryDef.title: sled hauler
BackstoryDef.description: Ore goes down the mountain by sled, along a route that kills somebody most years. [PAWN_nameDef] rode behind one and learned to jump off in time.

BackstoryDef.title: stolen by raiders
BackstoryDef.description: Bandits took [PAWN_nameDef] from the road for the ransom. The clan came with the ransom and a number of very large relatives. There was no further trouble.

BackstoryDef.title: Orsinium guard
BackstoryDef.description: Holding a wall is a family tradition among the Orcs, as is having it knocked down. [PAWN_nameDef] stood on Orsinium's walls and saw what comes next.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion auxiliary
BackstoryDef.description: Orcs make outstanding Imperial soldiers and are told this at great length, usually by officers who won't eat with them. [PAWN_nameDef] served twenty years.

BackstoryDef.title: blood-oath champion
BackstoryDef.description: When two clans dispute, each sends a champion so the rest don't have to die. [PAWN_nameDef] has been sent nine times, and came home each time.

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold warlord
BackstoryDef.description: It takes more than strength to hold several clans, though that does come first. [PAWN_nameDef] kept four strongholds together until a fifth got ideas.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragon Knight
BackstoryDef.description: The old Akaviri fighting arts didn't care what shape your tusks were. [PAWN_nameDef] learned them, and came home with an odd style and new scars.

BackstoryDef.title: bounty hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody's surprised when an Orc turns up at the door. [PAWN_nameDef] has collected on men who hid in three provinces.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain archer
BackstoryDef.description: Archers aren't what people expect from a stronghold. [PAWN_nameDef] has dropped several who didn't expect it.

BackstoryDef.title: berserker of Wrothgar
BackstoryDef.description: At some point in a fight, the pain stops mattering. [PAWN_nameDef] has been told what happens after that, though memory of it is thin.

BackstoryDef.title: ogre hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Ogres come down from the peaks when the snow gets deep. [PAWN_nameDef] went up to meet them each year with a heavy spear.

BackstoryDef.title: bandit chief
BackstoryDef.description: Being cast out doesn't end a career. [PAWN_nameDef] gathered other outcasts and took tolls on a road nobody could patrol.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan guard
BackstoryDef.description: Merchants like having a large Orc next to the wagon, and bandits like it less. [PAWN_nameDef] often got through entire seasons without having to fight at all.

BackstoryDef.title: mercenary sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: Sellswords will fight for anyone, but they listen to someone big. [PAWN_nameDef] ran a company from Rihad to Solitude and paid out on time.

BackstoryDef.title: war smith
BackstoryDef.description: Weapons get damaged in the field, and someone has to fix them there. [PAWN_nameDef] marched with a portable anvil and hit more than metal with the hammer.

BackstoryDef.title: arena champion
BackstoryDef.description: The crowds in Imperial City and Sentinel loved a good villain. [PAWN_nameDef] obliged for thirteen years, and retired with all but one ear.

BackstoryDef.title: Bretic war veteran
BackstoryDef.description: Bretons have marched on Orc lands more than once, usually when Orsinium starts doing well. [PAWN_nameDef] stood on the wall the last time and has never eaten a Breton pie since.

BackstoryDef.title: tracker of the high passes
BackstoryDef.description: Nothing moves through the passes without leaving marks. [PAWN_nameDef] read them for whichever clan was paying, and sometimes for the other one.

BackstoryDef.title: clan's shield
BackstoryDef.description: The chief goes through the door first, by law. [PAWN_nameDef] goes through it a half step ahead of the chief, by long agreement.

BackstoryDef.title: duel second
BackstoryDef.description: A proper grudge needs someone to carry messages and check the blades. [PAWN_nameDef] kept many feuds orderly, and only fought when things got sloppy.

BackstoryDef.title: Skyrim hold mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: Jarls will pay Orcs and then bar them from the hall. [PAWN_nameDef] took the coin, ate in the stable and kept a list.

BackstoryDef.title: siege sapper
BackstoryDef.description: Walls come down from the bottom. [PAWN_nameDef] dug under some of the best in High Rock, and rarely got buried for long.

BackstoryDef.title: boar rider
BackstoryDef.description: A war boar goes through a shield line better than most soldiers. [PAWN_nameDef] stays on one, most of the time.

BackstoryDef.title: peacekeeper of the Code
BackstoryDef.description: A stronghold's law has few words and all of them hurt. [PAWN_nameDef] enforced it for a chief who valued silence, and settled things quickly.

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold healer
BackstoryDef.description: The wise woman runs the stronghold's healing and spirit matters, and the chief is afraid of her. [PAWN_nameDef] learned at her side and keeps the herbs, the sickbeds and most of the secrets.

BackstoryDef.title: Malacath's priest
BackstoryDef.description: Malacath hears the wronged and despises the weak. [PAWN_nameDef] preaches on that basis, and doesn't soften it for visitors.

BackstoryDef.title: shaman of the mountain
BackstoryDef.description: The spirits on the high slopes don't care for being disturbed. [PAWN_nameDef] goes up to ask them anyway, and comes back smelling of smoke.

BackstoryDef.title: Trinimac revivalist
BackstoryDef.description: There are Orcs who claim the old god never really died. [PAWN_nameDef] is among them, and is not popular among the priests of Malacath.

BackstoryDef.title: battle shaman
BackstoryDef.description: Wounds need closing while the fight is still on, and someone has to stand there. [PAWN_nameDef] heals with one hand and uses a mace with the other.

BackstoryDef.title: Mages Guild oddity
BackstoryDef.description: An Orc in Guild robes attracts remarks, generally only once. [PAWN_nameDef] took the tests, passed them and earned a chapter hall's quiet respect.

BackstoryDef.title: forge-rune carver
BackstoryDef.description: Runes cut into a blade at the right heat will hold a charge for years. [PAWN_nameDef] learned it from an old smith who never admitted it was magic.

BackstoryDef.title: ancestor speaker
BackstoryDef.description: Some clans keep their dead close and ask their counsel. [PAWN_nameDef] passes along their replies, which tend to be rude.

BackstoryDef.title: bone reader
BackstoryDef.description: Thrown knuckle bones tell the chief when to march. [PAWN_nameDef] reads them truthfully, with some attention to what the chief already wants.

BackstoryDef.title: winter witch
BackstoryDef.description: Frost magic comes naturally when you grow up in Wrothgar. [PAWN_nameDef] lives apart, trades in remedies, and has been left alone since an unfortunate raid.

BackstoryDef.title: exile enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] left the clan to study enchanting among the Bretons, who were astonished and then expensive. Few ever bought from an Orc twice, though the work was fine.

BackstoryDef.title: stone-singer
BackstoryDef.description: Old miners say the rock tells you where it will crack. [PAWN_nameDef] sings low in the tunnels and listens, and has not lost a crew yet.

BackstoryDef.title: herbal poisoner
BackstoryDef.description: There's no shame in poison if the Code allows it. [PAWN_nameDef] knows precisely what the Code allows, down to the dose.

BackstoryDef.title: blood-rite keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Marriages, oaths and feuds all want a bit of blood at the right moment. [PAWN_nameDef] brings the knife and the bowl, and knows the words.

BackstoryDef.title: dream walker
BackstoryDef.description: A bitter root and a long fast take you somewhere useful. [PAWN_nameDef] has gone there often and returned with advice the chief was forced to take seriously.

BackstoryDef.title: master orcish smith
BackstoryDef.description: Orcish steel is the reason outsiders put up with Orcs. [PAWN_nameDef] has been offered gold by three kings and sold to one.

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold cook
BackstoryDef.description: Everyone in a stronghold has an opinion, and they all share it at dinner. [PAWN_nameDef] has outlasted most of the opinions.

BackstoryDef.title: echatere rancher
BackstoryDef.description: Nothing about an echatere is forgiving. [PAWN_nameDef] raises them for meat, wool and a certain professional pride.

BackstoryDef.title: wall mason
BackstoryDef.description: Orsinium has been rebuilt by the descendants of those who built it last. [PAWN_nameDef] puts stones where previous generations of the family put them.

BackstoryDef.title: clan tanner
BackstoryDef.description: Thick hides make good armor once you get past the smell. [PAWN_nameDef] got past it long ago, and is the only one who has.

BackstoryDef.title: highland farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Rye and tough roots are about all Wrothgar will grow. [PAWN_nameDef] grew them anyway, on terraces that took three generations to clear.

BackstoryDef.title: peddler to the clans
BackstoryDef.description: Strongholds will trade with their own kind where they would stab an outsider. [PAWN_nameDef] walked between them with a mule and many opinions on salt.

BackstoryDef.title: mead brewer
BackstoryDef.description: Good mead keeps a stronghold peaceful, and strong mead keeps the arguments interesting. [PAWN_nameDef] can produce either on request.

BackstoryDef.title: stonecutter
BackstoryDef.description: Dressed stone is worth more than rough, and a stronghold has plenty of time on its hands. [PAWN_nameDef] cut blocks in all weathers.

BackstoryDef.title: clan storyteller
BackstoryDef.description: Long winters need someone to fill them. [PAWN_nameDef] knows the clan's feuds back eleven generations, and which ones are still owed.

BackstoryDef.title: tusk carver
BackstoryDef.description: Echatere tusks make fine carving stock. [PAWN_nameDef]'s work has ended up on the walls of Imperial nobles, who were told it was Akaviri.

BackstoryDef.title: ironworker in Wayrest
BackstoryDef.description: City smiths will hire an Orc for the heavy work and then be amazed. [PAWN_nameDef] put up with that for many years and saved every coin.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial City docker
BackstoryDef.description: Lifting comes easily when you're built for it, and a dock doesn't ask questions. [PAWN_nameDef] worked the Waterfront until [PAWN_possessive] back gave out.

BackstoryDef.title: tax-paying merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Selling Orcish steel in Bretony means being polite in a language built for insults. [PAWN_nameDef] manages, and charges extra for the effort.

BackstoryDef.title: mule trainer
BackstoryDef.description: Mules respect stubbornness above all else, which gives Orcs an advantage. [PAWN_nameDef] could train any of them to walk a mountain ledge.

BackstoryDef.title: retired soldier
BackstoryDef.description: After enough years with the Legion, a small farm seems good. [PAWN_nameDef] went home with a pension and found the neighbors still wanted to fight.

BackstoryDef.title: healer without a title
BackstoryDef.description: Not everyone who sets a bone needs a stronghold's blessing. [PAWN_nameDef] treated whoever came, no questions, and a surprising number of Bretons.

BackstoryDef.title: outcast hermit
BackstoryDef.description: Cast out over a matter nobody now recalls, [PAWN_nameDef] built a hut above the snow line. Visitors are told to go away, with occasional soup.

BackstoryDef.title: bonesetter
BackstoryDef.description: Fights mean broken bones, and a stronghold has both in plenty. [PAWN_nameDef] sets them fast, on the theory that the patient may need the arm back by nightfall.

BackstoryDef.title: charcoal burner
BackstoryDef.description: Forges need clean coal, and it takes days of watching a smoking mound. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long seasons in the woods, smelling of it.

BackstoryDef.title: cooper
BackstoryDef.description: Anyone who says barrels are easy should try one. [PAWN_nameDef] made the casks that held the clan's mead, salt and, for a while, a very angry badger.

BackstoryDef.title: shepherd of the crags
BackstoryDef.description: Goats go where they like, and so must the shepherd. [PAWN_nameDef] knows every ledge in the valley, as well as the wolves who use them.

BackstoryDef.title: hide-boat maker
BackstoryDef.description: Orcs aren't sailors by reputation. [PAWN_nameDef] builds sturdy hide boats for the high lakes, and is tired of hearing the joke.

BackstoryDef.title: chieftain's scribe
BackstoryDef.description: The chief wants the tally kept, and doesn't read. [PAWN_nameDef] keeps it honest, more or less, and has become quietly powerful.

BackstoryDef.title: smelter
BackstoryDef.description: Molten ore does not forgive a slip. [PAWN_nameDef] poured for many years and has only the normal number of burns for the trade.

BackstoryDef.title: fur trader
BackstoryDef.description: Pelts from the high country sell well in Evermore. [PAWN_nameDef] brought them down every spring and came back with salt, needles and gossip.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter of the stronghold
BackstoryDef.description: A chief who's fed well is a calmer chief. [PAWN_nameDef] brings down what the valley provides and has a say in what's for supper.

BackstoryDef.title: ropemaker
BackstoryDef.description: Mine lift ropes have to hold, as everyone below knows. [PAWN_nameDef] twists them tight and rides on them personally to settle any doubts.

BackstoryDef.title: smelter's runner
BackstoryDef.description: Hot slag has to be dragged clear before it sets. [PAWN_nameDef] ran the drag line with a wet rag over the face, and came away with a loud voice and few eyebrows.
